name: Jason's Keys Apartment
description: Jason lives rent-free at one of Brian Heder's properties in the Keys. The likely starting safehouse.

name: Vice City Motel Room
description: Trailer 2's neon motel scenes point to a cheap early hideout in the city. Consensus pick, not confirmed.

name: Shared City Apartment
description: The Extended Look showed safehouse daily life: fridges, routines, Jason & Lucia living together. Exact spot TBC.

name: Port Gellhorn Room
description: A faded-resort-town bolthole for the northern arc. Pure prediction, marked honestly.

name: Jack of Hearts
description: Boobie Ike's strip club, straight from Rockstar's character pages and the Extended Look's dollar-bill rain.

name: Only Raw Records
description: Dre'Quan Priest's label, backed by Boobie's studio money. Real Dimez are the first big signing.

name: Tisha-Wocka Flea Market
description: Bootleg brands and open-air hustle, name-dropped in Rockstar's own Vice City description.

name: Little Cuba Panadería
description: Rockstar calls out the bustling panaderías of Little Cuba. Exact storefront TBC at launch.

name: Uncle Jack's Liquor
description: Liquor store visible in Trailer 1's Port Gellhorn getaway shot.

name: Port Gellhorn Pawn & Gun
description: Pawn shop signage caught in Trailer 1. Pawn, guns, and questionable decisions under one roof.

name: Heder's Boat Yard
description: Brian Heder, a golden-age smuggler, runs a boat yard in the Keys with Lori. Jason's employer.

name: Fence (Stolen Goods)
description: The Extended Look confirmed fences buy your stolen valuables. First city fence, exact shop TBC.

name: Gas Station (Robbable)
description: Gas station robberies are confirmed, so pick speed or profit. Rural stops like this one are prime targets.

name: Waffle Diner (Robbable)
description: The Extended Look showed a waffle-restaurant stickup. Name of the chain still unconfirmed.

name: Wyman's World Auto Salvage Co.
description: Wyman's salvage business, an Ultimate Edition perk. Map position is our guess until launch.

name: Gun Store
description: A Leonida gun chain is a series lock, but no storefront has been officially shown. Placeholder pin.

name: Prologue (Keys Start)
description: Press consensus: the story opens around Jason's life in the Keys. Structure marker until launch.

name: Runs for Brian Heder
description: Jason works for local drug runners, and Heder's smuggling jobs are all but certain early missions.

name: Raul Bautista's Crew
description: A seasoned bank robber always hunting for talent, in Rockstar's words. Expect heist work.

name: Only Raw Hustle
description: A music-scene story thread through Dre'Quan and Real Dimez feels inevitable. Unconfirmed.

name: Cal's Signal Watch
description: Cal Hampton monitors Coast Guard chatter from home. Surveillance-flavored jobs predicted.

name: Gellhorn Turf (Expected)
description: A story arc in the faded panhandle resort town is widely expected. Marker for structure only.

name: Stick-Up Jobs
description: Repeatable armed robberies confirmed: case the joint, then choose speed or profit. Cops respond.

name: WAINK Car Boosts
description: The WAINK app scans parked cars and shows their value. Confirmed: steal smart, not random.

name: Wildlife Study
description: Animals can be studied and new species tracked. Rockstar says there are over 170 species, some tracked as Rare, Discoverable or Legendary. Swamp = jackpot.

name: Ryde Me Gigs
description: The Ryde Me ride-hailing app is confirmed. Driving gigs for players are our speculation.

name: Real Dimez Promo Runs
description: Bae-Luxe and Roxy need clout. Side errands for the duo are informed speculation.

name: Keys Charter Work
description: Fishing and casual boating are confirmed in the Keys; charter side-work is our prediction.

name: Mud Crew Errands
description: Thrillbilly regulars always need parts hauled. Speculative flavor around a confirmed venue.

name: Thrillbilly Mud Club
description: The off-road mud park from Trailer 1: monster trucks, swamp buggies, and zero restraint.

name: Gellhorn International Raceway
description: Motorsport facility spotted in official material; race-car driving was shown in the Extended Look.

name: Street Basketball
description: Shooting hoops confirmed in the Extended Look sizzle reel.

name: Gym & Weights
description: Working out is confirmed, and your body actually changes with exercise, food, and sleep.

name: Boxing
description: Boxing appeared in the Extended Look's activity roll. Venue TBC.

name: Pool Hall
description: Billiards confirmed in the Extended Look. Hustle responsibly.

name: Shooting Range
description: Ranges confirmed in the Extended Look. Expect accuracy challenges.

name: Base Jumping
description: Basejumping confirmed. Downtown towers are the obvious launchpads.

name: Skydiving (Airport)
description: Parachuting confirmed; Leonida's big international airport west of the city is the natural hub.

name: Mini Golf
description: Mini golf confirmed in the Extended Look. Nine holes of pastel chaos.

name: Jet Ski Rental
description: Jet skiing confirmed, shown ripping along the beachfront in the Extended Look.

name: Electric Scooters
description: Electric scooter riding confirmed. The boardwalk will never be safe again.

name: Kayaking
description: Kayaking confirmed in the Extended Look. Calm water, big gators. Pick your line.

name: Lake Fishing
description: Fishing is confirmed both in Rockstar's Kalaga blurb and the Extended Look.

name: Kalaga Hunting Grounds
description: Rockstar's own Mount Kalaga description promises hunting in the national park.

name: Off-Road Trails
description: Off-road trails are part of Rockstar's official Kalaga pitch. Dirt bikes welcome.

name: Scuba Diving
description: Diving confirmed in the Extended Look, and the Keys hide the most dangerous waters in America.

name: Airboat Runs
description: Fanboat driving through the swamp, confirmed on camera in the Extended Look.

name: Dirt Bike Track
description: Dirtbiking and dirt-bike race tracks confirmed in the Extended Look.

name: Zoo
description: Zoos are on Game Informer's activity list, and one appeared in the Extended Look. Where it sits is still TBC, so the pin is provisional.

name: Snapmatic Spot: Ocean Beach
description: Snapmatic is back, officially. Pastel art-deco hotels + white sand = the obvious first shot.

name: Snapmatic Spot: Keys Bridge
description: The long overseas highway bridge from the trailers. Golden hour or don't bother.

name: Snapmatic Spot: Allied Crystal Refinery
description: Ambrosia's official landmark: the Allied Crystal sugar refinery, straight from Rockstar's blurb.

name: Snapmatic Spot: VC Port
description: Cruise ship capital of the world, per Rockstar. Shoot the big boats.

name: Snapmatic Spot: Kalaga Overlook
description: Highest ground in Leonida. Photo-spot checklists are our framing; the vista is real.

name: Hidden Packages (Expected)
description: Every GTA has a hidden-collectible set; none announced for VI yet. Placeholder for the city set.

name: Hidden Packages: Keys (Expected)
description: Series-tradition prediction for an island collectible chain. Honest guess, zero confirmation.

name: American Alligator
description: All over Trailer 1 and the official Grassrivers screenshots, including one in a gas station.

name: American Flamingo
description: A whole flamboyance opens Trailer 1. Shallow lagoons are their turf.

name: Brown Pelican
description: Seen cruising over the ocean in Trailer 1. Beachfront regular.

name: Bottlenose Dolphin
description: Spotted offshore in official footage. Boat out past the sandbar.

name: Sea Turtle
description: Rockstar's own Keys description promises sea turtles. Official, in writing.

name: Tiger Shark
description: Community-identified from trailer footage. The most dangerous waters in America, remember.

name: Key Deer
description: Community-spotted in footage: the tiny island deer, right where it belongs.

name: West Indian Manatee
description: Rockstar named manatees among Leonida's native species in September. Slow zone in the marina, please.

name: Raccoon
description: Caught raiding a trash can in Trailer 2. A professional.

name: Dogs (Pet / Scold / Study)
description: The Extended Look confirmed dog interactions: Pet, Scold, Study. We know which one you'll pick.

name: Green Iguana
description: Rockstar lists green iguanas among Leonida's invasive species. Sunning wherever it pleases.

name: Herring Gull
description: Community-identified beach menace. Guard your fries.

name: Wild Boar
description: One bolts across a chase sequence in Trailer 2. Farm country roamer.

name: White-tailed Deer
description: Hunting is official in Kalaga; whitetail as the headline species is community consensus.

name: Leonida Panther
description: The Florida panther's stand-in. A visitor report disputes our park placement, and real panthers keep to the southern swamps. Unverified until launch footage settles it.

name: Ocean Drive Throwback
description: The art-deco strip mirrors 2002's Vice City shot-for-shot in places. Callback hunting starts here.

name: Leonida Man Sightings
description: Trailer 1's hammer-toting rooftop rager and friends, Rockstar's love letter to real Florida headlines.

name: Swamp Lights Rumor
description: Every Rockstar map hides a UFO. Nothing confirmed for VI, so this pin is pure tradition.

name: Lake Monster Rumor
description: Community folklore, zero evidence. We keep it because mystery pins are fun and we said we'd be honest.
